title: Japanese Money Methods
note:
METHOD TWO — HARA HACHI BU. One mechanism held across three consecutive B
     scenes: ten cells, eight of them, then the last two leaving. The layout
     never moves; only what the cells are doing changes. s51 breaks the run and
     hands the same ratio to the measure bar in dollars.

     This chapter DIVERGES from the -hi row. 5.7 here is "a separate account,
     not the one the card touches" where -hi had 62.2%, and 62.2% moves to 5.9.
     The design follows the copy.

     Ground arc: warm -> neutral -> cool -> green across the instruction -> green
     on the split -> red at month-end zero -> green on the separate account ->
     neutral -> amber on Japan's own figure -> green on the $200 floor -> the
     chapter's hottest red on the honest caveat -> amber out.

     Archetypes: A B B B A A A A B B A A.

     disclaimer, so nothing drawn may imply a figure.

     fills to exactly 0.20 and stops.

s52.comment:
5.6 · A · PLATE · warn · red — DAY ONE, NOT DAY THIRTY. An open wallet with
     nothing in it already says zero.

s53.comment:
5.7 · A · PLATE · fund · green — AUTOMATICALLY, NOT HEROICALLY. Manila
     envelopes: separation, photographed. The footnote names no institution and
     nothing drawn may imply one. Art added 2026-08-06: the beat is a PROCESS and a flat photo is a FAIL for one, not a missed opportunity. Two containers, an arrow crossing, then the same move again — separation plus recurrence. No institution is named or implied.
